rules.title: San Francisco security deposit interest rate
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on tenant security deposits at the Rent Board rate, 4.2% for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 (5.0% the prior year).
rules.citation: S.F. Rent Board security deposit interest rate

notes: Rates page; names no code section for deposit interest, so citation is the Rent Board rate and confidence is low. The 1.6% allowable increase and relocation tables repeat D080 and D079/D082 and were not re-emitted.
